name: LoCoMo (window-pressure recall)
notes: Cross-episode RECALL under a bounded local window. Small chunk_size/local_window (1 accessible chunk) so a multi-session context pushes the answer-bearing first session OUT of the attention baseline's window. The answer is an entity-entity fact that Graphiti extracts reliably, so the test isolates persistence (external store vs bounded window), not extraction quality. Pair with `locomo` (supersession, everything in-window).
